measurementNotes: Recipe quantities describe the base number of servings. Fresh preparations keep their portion size; batch recipes scale to the selected plan. Follow the displayed ingredient amounts when adapting a linked source recipe.

Macros sum each measured ingredient’s nutrition reference, divided by servings. Meat and rice/pasta weights are raw/dry unless an ingredient explicitly says cooked or drained. Canned chicken uses drained weight; microwave rice uses cooked weight. Unmeasured optional garnishes and cooking spray are excluded. Ingredient references in meal-plan.json are editable: branded labels have links; generic foods use approximate assumptions.

Daily macro percentages use 4 calories per gram carbohydrate/protein and 9 per gram fat, normalized to 100%. Listed calories are summed separately from labels; fiber, alcohol and rounding can cause differences. Targets are 35% carbs / 35% protein / 30% fat, with a 3 percentage point tolerance; daily calorie totals allow 5%. Both regular and workout versions are checked. The pineapple-free shake & almonds preference allows up to 6 percentage points of deviation for the affected workout snacks only; its lower totals are shown without adjusting other meals.

Regular rice is measured dry: a cooked cup is modeled as about 60 g dry rice; cup-dry is 180 g. Ready-to-heat microwave rice is measured cooked and listed separately. Follow the package for actual water needs and yields. Meat conversion uses 454 g per pound.

Breakfast includes two lattes per person daily, each with 6 fl oz plain 2% ultra-filtered milk. Fairlife 2% reference per 8 fl oz: 120 calories, 13 g protein, 6 g carbohydrate, 4.5 g fat. MooTopia labels may differ; no syrup or added sugar is included.

PBfit Classic assumption per 16 g: 60 calories, 8 g protein, 4 g carbohydrate, 2 g fat. Some jars list different calories or carbohydrate; check yours. Fairlife fat-free milk per 8 fl oz: 80 calories, 13 g protein, 6 g carbohydrate, 0 g fat. This side shake is separate from latte milk.

Oat breakfast fat assumes butter: each full portion is 10 g butter, or the listed alternative of ¼ cup half-and-half. Alternate labels can change nutrition slightly. Steel-cut and rolled oats are separate shopping items.

Pineapple bowls include one entire Dole 4 oz (113 g) pineapple-in-juice cup, 60 calories and 15 g carbohydrate, including juice. Cottage cheese assumes Good Culture 2%: 90 calories, 14 g protein, 4 g carbohydrate, 2 g fat per 110 g. Use your actual tub and fruit labels.

Packaged snacks use the stated sizes: KIND Dark Chocolate Nuts & Sea Salt 40 g; Oikos Triple Zero vanilla 150 g; Mini Babybel Original 20 g. A workout replacement contains one Fairlife Nutrition Plan chocolate shake (150 calories, 30 g protein, 4 g carbohydrate, 2.5 g fat). Grocery totals cover regular snacks; compare workout guide ingredients before shopping.

Generic food assumptions include nonfat Greek yogurt, 93% lean beef, boneless skinless chicken thighs, lean pork tenderloin and mixed vegetables at 65 calories per 100 g. These are estimates; specific brands and vegetable blends can differ.

Slow-cooker chili uses whole cans at the selected plan size, drained beans and measured raw chicken. Divide the entire cooked batch equally; keep dairy toppings separate. The three-day 2,400-calorie plan has chili on days 1 and 2, then pork on day 3.

No meal family is scheduled more than two days in a row. Portion variants count as the same family. Fish, seafood and turkey are excluded; honey-garlic chicken uses vegetarian mushroom sauce in place of oyster sauce.

Shopping amounts round up to the configured increment or package size. Berries use about 150 g per cup. Garlic assumes about 10 cloves per head. Lemon juice assumes 2 tablespoons per lemon. Fraction strings keep recipe quantity calculations exact.

Fatigue plans are single days with one dining-out lunch and an assembled dinner; you can swap those time slots. The dining-out purchase is listed separately from grocery ingredients. Breakfast still includes both 6 fl oz milk lattes.

Chipotle order estimates sum standard ingredients from its official U.S. nutrition chart. Panda Express orders sum its current official table: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken 280 calories / 38 g protein per 6.1 oz entrée; Super Greens side 180 calories per 10 oz; white steamed rice 570 calories per 12 oz. Half-and-half sides use half each standard side. Checked 2026-10-11; portions can vary and extra sauce/drinks are excluded.

Fatigue pantry meals use Swanson fully cooked canned chicken at 80 calories / 15 g protein / 1 g carbs / 1.5 g fat per 85 g drained. Shopping rounds the required drained weight upward; check your cans’ edible yield. BEN’S ORIGINAL Ready Rice jasmine uses the official per-cup (143 g cooked) reference, 250 calories / 4 g protein / 51 g carbs / 3 g fat. Microwave rice is separate from dry rice; refrigerate unused cooked portions. Use actual labels if different.

The Fairlife shake & almonds workout snack omits pineapple and its now-unused vanilla/sweetener. It contains one 30 g protein / 150 calorie shake plus the existing measured almonds. Regular cottage cheese bowls still include their pineapple-in-juice cup; regular groceries are unchanged.
